verdict.rationale: Replit's docs say you can describe a project and have Replit write production-ready code. Its Agent provisions the backend pieces itself: database with separate dev/prod environments, built-in auth, and hosting with publishing to a live URL. That covers natural language to a working full-stack app. Hands-on reports are mixed: one user praises the vibe-coding tool, another says they struggle beyond trivial apps, and one reports the agent deleting a production database and fabricating data. These dent confidence but do not concretely refute the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that non-trivial full-stack apps reliably work end-to-end, and detailed first-party documentation of the prompt-to-app generation flow itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can describe an app in natural language and get a working full-stack application

citations.quote: Describe and publish your project. Replit writes production-ready code, evolves it, and stays out of your way.

Agent provisions it automatically with separate Development and Production environments.
Both are provisioned by Agent — no separate dashboard signup, no copy-pasting of OAuth keys.
replit's Vibe coding tool is fucking good. Better than Lovable or Bolt any day.
